content.rendered:
We started with a simple belief — every business deserves a digital presence that actually works.

Founded by Shahzad Sadiq, Lushah was built on a foundation most digital agencies don't have — 20 years of jewellery design. That background taught us that the finest work lives in the details: the precision of a setting, the weight of a word, the flow of a layout. We brought that same obsession with craft into the digital world.

Today we're a full-service digital studio specialising in Shopify and WordPress development for businesses across Canada and the United States. From your first online store to a complete brand overhaul — we make the process straightforward and the results undeniable.

A Word From Our Founder


Lushah was born from a simple idea — great businesses deserve a digital presence that's just as carefully crafted as everything else they do. Over 20 years designing jewellery, I learned that the finest work lives in the details: a proportion that's slightly off, a line that doesn't flow, a finish that isn't quite right — you feel it, even if you can't name it. I brought that same obsession into the digital world.

I started Lushah to help businesses build something real online — whether that's a Shopify store that sells with confidence, a WordPress site that tells your story the right way, or a brand identity that finally feels true to who you are. Not templates. Not shortcuts. Work that's actually built around you.

Every project I take on, I treat as if it were my own business on the line. That's not a tagline — it's just how I work. Seeing a client's idea come alive on screen, and knowing it's already bringing them customers, is still the best part of what I do.

"In jewellery, a single misplaced detail ruins the whole piece. I design every website the same way — nothing is an afterthought."
Shahzad Sadiq
Founder
